_about: All experiment settings for GP4 version 1. Fixed BEFORE any live run. Never edit after a live run: copy to config_v2.json, change it there, and record the reason in CHANGELOG.md. Keys starting with an underscore are notes for humans and are ignored by the code.
_signed_off_note: Live runs are blocked until signed_off is true. Set it to true only after Dale approves every PROPOSED value below.
_model_note: APPROVED 2026-11-05. Vision-capable OpenAI model. temperature is sent only if the model accepts it; otherwise it is left blank in the data and the run log says so.
_image_note: APPROVED 2026-11-05. image_detail is low, high or auto. pad_images_to_common_canvas is off by default; if switched on it must be listed in DEVIATIONS.md.
_prompt_note: Prompt folder used. prompt_file_sha256 holds fingerprints of the signed-off text (line endings normalised to LF, final newline removed). The code refuses to run if the files no longer match, so v1 cannot be edited in place.
_persona_note: APPROVED 2026-11-05. persona_mode is student or none. pct_male matches the original Study 3 sample (49% male). Gender quota is applied within each condition so gender cannot be confounded with condition.
_scale_note: APPROVED 2026-11-05. Arousal maximum. 9 matches the original affect grid and the instructor's prompt. OPEN QUESTION for Dr. Zhang (overview text says 7). Must match the prompt text: the code checks this.
_assignment_note: APPROVED 2026-11-05. Seed for the reproducible random assignment of conditions and genders.
_run_sizes_note: Number of agents per run label. main matches the original n = 77 (39 high, 38 low). robustness matches the replication n = 823 and is always labelled robustness.
_call_note: APPROVED 2026-11-05. max_attempts is the total number of tries per agent (first try plus retries). workers is how many agents are called at the same time; each call is still independent.
_analysis_note: APPROVED 2026-11-05. tost_bound_inches is the equivalence bound for the size effect (plus or minus, in inches). alpha is the significance level for all tests.
_dashboard_note: Keep false. When true, the dashboard shows a Run page that can spend API money.
